description: PAID. Turns one composed screen into a TSX file for an app that already exists, with its own navigator and routes. Returns the complete file inline, the components to install first, and how to mount it. For a whole app with navigation and a tab bar, emit_app is the matching tool. Needs the share code from the App Builder.

componentName.description: React component name for the file, e.g. "CheckoutScreen". Defaults to GeneratedScreen.

name: emit_screen
title: Emit a single screen
